functional_contract.available_state: Agent at room center with full list of visible receptacles; target object not yet observed; inventory empty.
constraints: Must eventually find and acquire the target if present in any reachable receptacle
Must not interact with or pick up non-target objects during search
Must open closed receptacles before inspecting their contents
functional_contract.local_function: Systematically navigate to and inspect receptacles in listed order until the target object is found, then take it into inventory.
functional_contract.required_downstream_state: Target object held in agent inventory; agent located at the receptacle where the target was found.

c_candidate.guidance: Navigate directly to the cooling appliance first. Open it if closed and inspect for the target object. If found, take it and proceed with the cooling routine. If not found, continue searching other semantically plausible receptacles in listed order.
c_candidate.hypothesis: Prioritizing the dedicated cooling appliance as the first search location—since it must be visited later in the task anyway—reduces total navigation steps compared to both strict listed-order traversal and generic semantic plausibility heuristics that do not account for downstream task requirements.

probe_spec.adaptive_policy: Select the cooling appliance from the current observation's admissible go-to actions. Upon arrival, issue an open action if the observation indicates it is closed, then inspect. If the target object is observed, take it. If the target is absent, resume searching other receptacles using the established listed-order guidance.
probe_spec.evidence_goal: Whether navigating to the cooling appliance first successfully locates the target object or reduces total search steps compared to visiting receptacles in strict listed order or by generic surface priority.
probe_spec.local_function: Initial receptacle selection during target object search
probe_spec.realization_pattern: Navigate to the dedicated cooling appliance first; open if required; inspect contents; acquire target if present; otherwise fall back to systematic search of remaining receptacles.
probe_spec.required_downstream_state: Target object held in agent inventory; agent located at the receptacle where the target was found.
stop_conditions: Target object is found and taken into inventory
Cooling appliance has been opened and inspected without finding the target object
An action fails or returns an error
